newsitem.title: USA: Showboat Inc opens Chicago-area casino.
newsitem.headline: Showboat Inc opens Chicago-area casino.

text.p: Showboat Inc said Friday its Showboat Mardi Gras Casino in East Chicago, Indiana, officially opened to the public today.
The 158,000-square-foot facility will feature 1,769 slot machines and 90 table games and the only dedicated poker room in the area, Showboat said.
Earlier this week, the company said the Indiana Gaming Commission issued a conditional gaming license for the casino.
Showboat is a casino development company.
Its shares were up 1/4 Friday at 20-3/8.
